ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge credential verification module extending MOSIP's ID system, enabling third-party verifiers to authenticate identity attributes without exposing raw PII.
ideas.title: MOSIP-VerifyLink
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets MOSIP's core guiding principles of modularity, security, and privacy by implementing a privacy-preserving layer suitable for cross-border digital public goods.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed biometric deduplication and matching gateway designed for remote areas with intermittent internet connectivity, syncing securely back to central MOSIP instances.
ideas.title: BiometricEdge-Offline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real-world adoption friction for developing nations where infrastructure limitations hinder national ID rollouts, aligning with the evaluation priority of practical national scale.

ideas.pitch: An AI-governed compliance auditor that automatically analyzes custom country integrations against MOSIP's specification constraints and data privacy mandates.
ideas.title: MOSIP-PolicyAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses agentic compliance checking to reduce the review burden on core maintainers, matching the successful patterns seen in automated governance and pre-deployment diagnostics.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight companion application giving citizens real-time cryptographic audit logs of every time their foundational digital ID was queried or verified by external services.
ideas.title: ConsentVault-Mobile
ideas.why_it_could_win: Empowers end-users with transparency and control over their identity data, addressing critical civic trust challenges in national infrastructure projects.

ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first onboarding wizard that helps rural field officers register citizens into custom MOSIP country implementations in regional and tribal dialects.
ideas.title: Multilingual-MOSIP-Onboarder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets accessibility and inclusion barriers in emerging markets, making it a high-impact submission for international judges looking for broad social utility.
